situations.title: 수술 전 인계 수신
situations.tagline: I'm the OR nurse, walk me through her preop handoff before we bring her back.
situations.brief: 병동 간호사에게서 수술 전 인계를 SBAR로 수신하세요.
keyPhrases: Give me the SBAR before she comes back.
Confirm her NPO status and last vitals.
Let me read that back to make sure I have it.

situations.title: SBAR 구조 인계
situations.tagline: Let's keep this handoff in SBAR so nothing gets missed.
situations.brief: SBAR 형식에 맞춰 구조적으로 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: Situation, background, assessment, recommendation.
I'll give you each part in order.
Stop me if you need me to expand any section.

situations.title: 알레르기·금식 인계
situations.tagline: Two things I need first, her allergies and her NPO time.
situations.brief: 알레르기와 금식 상태 등 필수 정보를 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: She's allergic to penicillin, no latex issues.
NPO since midnight, confirmed with the patient.
Any changes to her allergy list today?

situations.title: 수술 부위·동의 인계
situations.tagline: Let's verify the surgical site and that consent is signed and matches.
situations.brief: 수술 부위와 동의서를 인계하고 대조하세요.
keyPhrases: The consent reads left knee, and the site is marked.
Confirm the mark matches the consent and the schedule.
Any discrepancy, we stop and clarify.

situations.title: 활력·검사 인계
situations.tagline: Here are her latest vitals and labs before we take her back.
situations.brief: 활력징후와 검사 결과를 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: Her last BP was 128 over 76, heart rate 72.
Hemoglobin and coags are within range.
Type and screen is on file.

situations.title: 인계 기록 작성
situations.tagline: Let's document this handoff so it's all captured in the record.
situations.brief: 인계 내용을 기록으로 남기세요.
keyPhrases: I'll chart what we handed off and when.
Note who gave and who received the report.
Anything verbal also goes in the record.

situations.title: 마취팀 인계 협조
situations.tagline: Let's line up the nursing and anesthesia handoff so our stories match.
situations.brief: 마취팀과 협조해 인계 정보를 맞추세요.
keyPhrases: Let's confirm the airway plan and access together.
Our allergy and NPO info should match.
Tell me the anesthetic plan for my notes.

situations.title: OR→PACU 인계
situations.tagline: Ready for the handoff? Let me give you SBAR before she wakes up.
situations.brief: 수술 종료 후 PACU 간호사에게 SBAR로 마취와 수술 경과를 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: Situation, she's post-op lap chole, extubated and stable.
General anesthesia, estimated blood loss was minimal.
Read back the drips and her last pain med.

situations.title: PACU→병동 인계
situations.tagline: She's ready for the floor, let me hand off her recovery course to you.
situations.brief: 회복이 끝난 환자를 병동 간호사에게 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: She met discharge criteria from PACU.
Pain's controlled, last dose was thirty minutes ago.
Here are her lines, drains, and activity orders.

situations.title: 집도의 술중 소견 인계
situations.tagline: Give me the intraoperative findings so I can hand them off accurately.
situations.brief: 집도의의 술중 소견을 인계에 반영하세요.
keyPhrases: What were the key intraoperative findings?
Any complications I should pass along?
I'll include that in the PACU handoff.

situations.title: 이식물·기기 정보 인계
situations.tagline: Let me hand off the implant details and the device card for her chart.
situations.brief: 이식물과 기기 정보를 정확히 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: Here's the implant type, size, and lot number.
The device card goes in her permanent record.
Note the manufacturer for future imaging.

situations.title: 계수·검체 결과 인계
situations.tagline: Counts are correct and here's how the specimens were sent.
situations.brief: 계수 결과와 검체 처리 내용을 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: Final count is correct, times two.
The specimen went to pathology, labeled and logged.
Confirm the specimen requisition matches.

situations.title: 통역 통한 인계 확인
situations.tagline: Let's use the interpreter to confirm the handoff details with the patient.
situations.brief: 통역을 통해 인계 정보를 환자와 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's get the interpreter on the line.
Ask her to confirm the surgery and site.
Have her repeat it back through the interpreter.

situations.title: 인계 중 정보 누락 확인
situations.tagline: I don't see her anticoagulation on here, let's fill that gap before we proceed.
situations.brief: 인계 중 누락된 정보를 찾아 보완하세요.
keyPhrases: There's a gap, no mention of her blood thinners.
When was the last dose held?
Let's not proceed until that's clarified.

situations.title: 다과 인계 우선순위
situations.tagline: We've got several handoffs stacking up, let's prioritize the unstable one first.
situations.brief: 여러 인계가 겹칠 때 우선순위를 정하세요.
keyPhrases: The unstable patient's handoff goes first.
Let's stagger these so nothing gets rushed.
Who can take the routine transfer?

situations.title: 응급 이송 신속 인계
situations.tagline: This is an emergency transfer, let me give you a fast focused SBAR to the ICU.
situations.brief: 응급 이송 상황에서 신속하게 핵심만 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: Situation, unstable post-op, heading to the ICU now.
Active drips, secured airway, two units hung.
Read back the critical items only.

situations.title: 불안정 환자 인계
situations.tagline: She's still unstable, so let's do this handoff carefully at the bedside together.
situations.brief: 불안정한 환자를 신중하게 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: Her pressure's labile, keep the pressor titrating.
Let's not disconnect anything mid-report.
I'll stay until you're comfortable with her.

situations.title: 인계 오류 환자 위험
situations.tagline: The handoff I got doesn't match the chart, we need to stop and reconcile this.
situations.brief: 인계 오류로 인한 환자 위험을 차단하세요.
keyPhrases: What you told me conflicts with her orders.
We can't proceed on mismatched information.
Let's reconcile the chart before anything else.

situations.title: 술중 합병증 인계
situations.tagline: There was a complication during the case, let me hand off exactly what happened.
situations.brief: 술중 합병증을 다음 팀에 정확히 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: We had significant bleeding that we controlled.
Here's what we did and the response.
Watch closely for signs it recurs.

situations.title: 인계 누락 사고 대응
situations.tagline: A key detail got dropped in handoff and it affected her care, let's address it now.
situations.brief: 인계 누락으로 발생한 사고에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Her allergy wasn't passed along and she got the drug.
Let's manage the patient first, then report it.
We need a handoff process fix so this can't repeat.
goals: 인계 누락 사고를 인지하고 환자를 먼저 안정화한다

situations.title: 위기 폐쇄루프 인계
situations.tagline: This is a critical transfer, so every item gets a read-back and a confirmation.
situations.brief: 위기 상황에서 폐쇄루프(closed-loop)로 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll say it, you read it back, I'll confirm.
Epi drip at ten, read that back to me.
Nothing moves until each item is confirmed.
